description: This file defines the ProfileRepository class for managing user profiles, including methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and authorizing access to profiles within a project. It interacts with a Prisma ORM and includes various utility functions and constants related to profiles and organizations.

classes.name: ProfileRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling profile data operations, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and access control logic.

methods.name: generateProfileUid
methods.description: Generates a new UUID for profile identification.

methods.name: findUserByid
methods.description: Retrieves a user by ID with selected fields, parsing metadata.

methods.name: getInheritedDataFromUser
methods.description: Extracts inherited profile data from a user object.

methods.name: getLookupTarget
methods.description: Parses a profile ID string into a lookup target object.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Creates a new profile record in the database.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a profile with email-derived username if needed.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Creates or updates a profile record based on provided data.

methods.name: createForExistingUser
methods.description: Creates a profile for an existing user.

methods.name: createManyForExistingUsers
methods.description: Creates profiles for multiple existing users and links them.

methods.name: createManyPromise
methods.description: Creates multiple profiles asynchronously.

methods.name: createMany
methods.description: Creates multiple profiles synchronously.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a profile by user and organization ID.

methods.name: deleteMany
methods.description: Deletes multiple profiles by user IDs.

methods.name: findByUserIdAndOrgId
methods.description: Finds a profile by user ID and organization ID.

methods.name: findByOrgIdAndUsername
methods.description: Finds a profile by organization ID and username.

methods.name: findByUid
methods.description: Finds a profile by its UID.

methods.name: findByUpIdWithAuth
methods.description: Finds a profile by UpId with authorization checks.

methods.name: checkOrgAdminAccessToUser
methods.description: Checks if requesting user has admin access to target user within orgs.

methods.name: checkUserAccessToProfile
methods.description: Verifies if a user has access to a specific profile.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a profile by its ID.

methods.name: findManyByOrgSlugOrRequestedSlug
methods.description: Finds profiles by organization slug or requested slug.

methods.name: findAllProfilesForUserIncludingMovedUser
methods.description: Retrieves all profiles for a user, including moved profiles.

methods.name: findManyForUsers
methods.description: Retrieves profiles for multiple user IDs.

methods.name: findManyForUser
methods.description: Retrieves profiles for a specific user.

methods.name: findFirstForUserId
methods.description: Finds the first profile for a user ID.

methods.name: findFirstOrganizationIdForUser
methods.description: Gets the first organization ID associated with a user.

methods.name: findManyForOrg
methods.description: Retrieves profiles for a specific organization.

methods.name: findByUserIdAndProfileId
methods.description: Finds a profile by user ID and profile ID.

methods.name: findByUserIdAndOrgSlug
methods.description: Finds a profile by user ID and organization ID.

methods.name: buildPersonalProfileFromUser
methods.description: Builds a personal profile object from user data.

methods.name: _getPrismaWhereForProfilesOfOrg
methods.description: Generates Prisma query filter for profiles of an organization by slug.
